metrics.label: AMI (↑ more stable)
metrics.why: Agreement of Run A vs. Run B AI.CLASSIFY intent labels across all 1,186 steps, adjusted for random luck.

metrics.label: Unseen Hack Coverage (↑ more hacks)
metrics.why: % of the ~1,086 unseen flagged steps assigned to any hack intent (excluding Honest, Audit, Declare complete, and None).

metrics.label: Macro Hack Confidence (↑ crisper codes)
metrics.why: Average Quail 27B top-1 probability per hack intent on unseen steps, averaged equally across all hack intents in the codebook.

metrics.label: Cluster V-Measure (↑ cleaner groups)
metrics.why: Harmonic mean of cluster homogeneity & completeness comparing raw k = 10 clusters against Union Consensus intents.

metrics.label: Dataset NMI (↓ less dataset bias)
metrics.why: Normalized mutual information between raw k = 10 cluster IDs and the 9 benchmark names (0 = no dataset bias).
